name: Schönbrunn Palace
desc: 1,441 rooms of Habsburg excess. The gardens and Gloriette hill are free — climb up and pity emperors with worse views than yours.

name: St. Stephen's Cathedral
desc: The tiled-roof cathedral at Vienna's dead center. Standing in the nave costs nothing; the shiver is complimentary.

name: Belvedere Palace
desc: Baroque palace holding Klimt's golden Kiss. One ticket to see the most famous hug in art history.

name: Prater & Riesenrad
desc: Free-entry park with an 1897 ferris wheel spinning slow-motion movie history. Ride it someday; loiter beneath it tonight.

name: Naschmarkt
desc: A mile of stalls — olives, cheese, Saturday flea-market chaos. Grazing the free samples is basically a Viennese sport.

name: Kunsthistorisches Museum
desc: Bruegel, Vermeer, and a marble stairwell built to humble you. The café under the dome might be Europe's prettiest room.

name: Stadtpark
desc: Home of the golden Strauss statue, frozen mid-waltz. Free lawns, free swans, free soundtrack in your head.

name: Vienna State Opera
desc: World-class opera with standing tickets for pocket change. Stand tall and absorb high culture at kebab prices.

name: Hofburg Palace
desc: The Habsburgs' winter HQ — imperial apartments, Sisi's story, and enough chandeliers to cover your rent for years.

name: Donauinsel
desc: A 21 km river island of beaches, grill spots and bike paths. Vienna's free summer resort — no reservation required.
